column1: Garbage has not been collected in our street for the last 10 days. The stench is completely unbearable, and it is attracting a swarm of flies and stray dogs.
A massive, deep pothole has opened up right in the middle of the school zone crossing. Several bikes have slipped already, presenting a severe risk of accidents.
There is a completely exposed live electrical wire hanging from the pole near the kids' park on Main Street. This is an immediate fire and life threat!
The tap water in our residential area is coming out brown and smells strongly of sewage. Residents are falling ill after consuming it.
Stray dogs are barking aggressively and attacking school children near the entrance during the afternoon. Parents are highly concerned about safety.
Low water pressure in our building makes it extremely difficult to perform daily tasks like washing or cooking.
The streetlights in the sector 4 residential lane have been completely dead for 2 weeks, making the street pitch black and prone to petty thefts.
A major water leakage from the main pipeline on the highway is wasting thousands of liters of clean water and causing minor traffic delays.
Frequent power cuts and high voltage fluctuations are happening every afternoon, damaging home refrigerators and TV sets.
Someone has dumped construction debris and large concrete blocks on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on the main road traffic.
